hooks.command:

%s
%s
' "$ws" "$hint" >&2; exit 2; fi; if tc=$(pnpm -w run typecheck 2>&1); then exit 0; fi; errs=$(printf '%s
' "$tc" | /usr/bin/grep -E 'error TS' | /usr/bin/head -n 20); if [ -z "$errs" ]; then errs=$(printf '%s
' "$tc" | /usr/bin/tail -n 20); fi; printf 'Quick checks failed: pnpm -w run typecheck.
%s
%s
' "$errs" "$hint" >&2; exit 2
